meta_description: Merlx Electrical Services in Sheffield. Domestic and commercial electrical work, rewires, testing and inspections. Fast, reliable, fully certified. Call 07493 113103.
hero_subhead: Blown fuse or faulty wiring in Sheffield? We diagnose and fix electrical faults fast, with no hidden charges.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full rewires, we handle domestic and commercial electrical work with precision and care.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Power cuts, faulty sockets, and burning smells demand immediate action. We attend call-outs within the hour and carry full diagnostic equipment on the van.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Old wiring poses fire and safety risks. We replace outdated systems with modern, compliant installations and test every circuit before completion.

services.title: Periodic Electrical Testing
services.desc: Annual inspections protect your home and satisfy insurance requirements. We produce a detailed report and flag any work needed.

services.title: New Circuit Installation
services.desc: Adding circuits for kitchens, bathrooms, or outdoor spaces. We design layouts for safety and convenience, then install to Building Regulations.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Old fuse boards are dangerous. We install modern consumer units with RCD protection, giving you safer power distribution and peace of mind.

services.title: Commercial Electrical Work
services.desc: Businesses rely on uninterrupted power. We handle installations, maintenance, and emergency call-outs with minimal disruption to your operations.

about_pullquote: We show up on time, fix it right, and don't take shortcuts.
about_para_1: Merlx Electrical Services has been serving Sheffield homes and businesses for over 12 years. We started because we believe electrical work should be straightforward: clear pricing, skilled hands, and no jargon. Every engineer carries full diagnostic kit and parts, so most faults are fixed the same day.
about_para_2: Our reputation rests on reliability and honesty. We turn up when we say we will, explain what's wrong in plain English, and only charge for work we actually do. Repeat customers and personal referrals make up the bulk of our work—that's how we know we're doing it right.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Customers Say About Merlx

reviews.text: Had a scary moment when lights started flickering all over the house. Called Merlx at 9pm and they were here by 10. Turned out a loose connection in the consumer unit. Fixed it on the spot, explained everything clearly, and didn't overcharge. Really professional outfit.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: We needed a full rewire before selling. Mike and his team were brilliant—they kept disruption to a minimum, cleaned up after themselves, and the testing was thorough. Got our EICR certificate on the day. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Jennifer P.

reviews.text: Kitchen renovation nightmare until Merlx stepped in. They worked with the builder, ran new circuits to exactly where we needed them, and everything passed inspection first time. Fair price, no mess. Will use them again when we do the bathroom.
reviews.author: Marcus B.
